messages:
maria: starting a targeted admin entitlement cleanup in staging today. scope: svcaccts with project-level owner/editor + any project KMS bindings. will run canary in staging-x then staging-y.

devon: ok. please post the runbook link and blackout windows. also note we should not overlap with infra-nightly jobs.

natalie: runbook posted: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/admin-entitlement-cleanup. blackout: 02:30-04:30 UTC. rollback steps in section 2.

irfan: FYI last scan found 4 legacy deployer accounts with project-level KMS grants. those need manual approval before change. flagging them now.

maria: plan: automated detection -> open remediation tickets for KMS hits -> canary remove owner role on non-KMS SAs -> monitor. tickets will include suggested key-level policy.

sec-bot: [alert] detected project-level KMS grant on svcacct:legacy-deployer@redwood-staging at 2026-03-21T08:45:10Z. created ticket SEC-7230.

devon: I'll perform the canary in staging-x at 09:15. @sre-oncall please watch KMS decrypt metrics and job failures for 20m after change.

sre-oncall: will watch logs and set a 15m alert window for increased Decrypt error rate. I'll also snapshot relevant audit log queries.

maria: example detection command (do not run on prod):
```bash
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-staging --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role=="roles/owner" or .role=="roles/editor")'
```

irfan: remediation guidance for tickets:
- remove project-level grant
- add key-level binding: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on specific key
- update terraform state if referenced

devon: adding commands to ticket:
```bash
# remove project-level grant
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-staging --member="serviceAccount:legacy-deployer@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/owner"
# add key-level binding
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding my-key --location=global --keyring=my-ring --member="serviceAccount:legacy-deployer@..." --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
```

maria: canary output (trimmed):
2026-03-21T09:15:12Z removed roles/owner from svcacct-canary-01
2026-03-21T09:15:30Z no Decrypt errors observed in workflows touching keys (0 -> 0)
2026-03-21T09:18:45Z one unrelated job retried and succeeded

sre-oncall: confirmed — no crypto errors. will proceed with staging-y tomorrow.

natalie: reminder to ticket owners: include audit log snippets for evidence and a PR link if terraform changes are required. retention policy insists on attaching this to the ticket.

irfan: watch for external integrations referencing these SAs (webhooks, partner connectors). coordinate with infra to avoid drift in terraform.

maria: propose cadence: weekly sweep in staging, monthly for prod after approvals. any concerns?

devon: +1 to weekly in staging, monthly for prod.

sre-oncall: +1 and I'll add a monitor for KMS decrypt spike post-PR rollouts.

maria: great, closing this thread. will post a full post-canary summary once staging-y completes :thumbsup:
